name: mosfet-load-switch
prompt: Build a circuit where an ESP32 GPIO switches a 12 V resistive heater element (model it as a generic load) using an N-channel MOSFET as a low-side switch. Include a gate series resistor and a gate pulldown so the heater stays off at boot.
notes: Same combination rules as motor-driver but a resistive load, so no flyback diode is required — an agent that cargo-cults the motor recipe adds one harmlessly, but one that omits the pulldown fails the assertion.
